svg.title: The complete boundary map and its central kernel
svg.desc: The boundary group P j maps onto the zero-section group Gamma j. Its full kernel is the infinite cyclic group generated by h j, the inverse positive normal-circle loop. The explicit isomorphism Phi j identifies P j with Gamma j times the integers. The second coordinate of h j is minus one. These are exact group maps proved in Lesson 2, Theorem 4.1 and Corollary 4.2, not a drawing of the spaces.

g.text: The whole attachment kernel keeps the clockwise sign
